faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: We answer the most common questions about the service, implementation and investment.

1.q: What exactly does the AI automation service include?
1.a: We deploy artificial intelligence agents that take on real tasks in your operation: sales, support, lead qualification, scheduling and social media management, on the channels you already use (WhatsApp, voice calls, Instagram and your website). It's not a bot with pre-scripted answers: it's a system trained on your business information that converses, qualifies and closes on its own.

2.q: What's the process after I request my free audit?
2.a: An automation expert analyzes your current operation (channels, volume, funnel) and gives you a diagnosis with the conversion leaks detected. From there we design a custom agent architecture, present a transparent price proposal and deploy the complete system in 15-30 days.

3.a: No. All MetaTok plans run with no lock-in and no hidden fees. You can scale, change plans or cancel whenever you need to: our goal is to earn your loyalty through results, not a contract.

4.a: Every business has different channels, conversation volume and integrations. Instead of selling you a generic package, we audit your real operation and present an investment based on the exact complexity of your case, with no fine print.

5.q: How long does full implementation take?
5.a: Between 15 and 30 days from the initial audit to the system live in production, including agent programming, training on your business information, and integrations with your CRM or current tools. Your team never touches code at any point.

6.q: How are your agents different from a regular chatbot?
6.a: A traditional chatbot follows a static decision tree and hands off to a human as soon as the conversation gets complicated. MetaTok agents use generative AI: they understand intent and context, overcome objections and are trained to close the sale or the appointment, not just provide information.
